details.publicNotes:
Born from the souls of mortals whose songs have stirred the hearts of the masses in life, emirads carry the song that resonates across the rolling plains of Elysium in their hearts. Emirads embody the harmony among those who join together in song, as well as the power of music to unite people and bridge the cultural gap between them. These titanic musicians travel far and wide, eager to learn new musical pieces and styles to refine their craft. Because of this, they often blend the music of various cultures and nations around the world, and even across the planes.

Emirads often dwell in isolated locales to avoid disturbing others with their supernaturally booming voices. This habit can lead to rumors of "wailing sirens" calling down from hidden valleys and ensnaring the hearts of those who listen too closely.

The greatest among the emirad are known as emirad idols. These taller, more powerful idols have perfected their craft to the point that their songs can stop warring armies in their tracks.

Sing it From the Mountaintops

Besides fine voices, emirads have exceptionally good hearing, especially for melody. While a mortal a mile away can hear an emirad's song, another emirad can hear the same tune from dozens or even hundreds of miles away. Distant emirads often sing together in complex, multipart harmonies, a practice that puzzles mortals who can hear only one of the vocal parts.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 125/275/500 gp

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Your symphony lifts listeners from their worldly concerns. Attempt a Performance check to counteract an effect applying one of the following conditions to the target: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}. If you fail, you can't target the same effect on the target for 1 day. Use the condition's source to determine the counteract DC (for example, the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC for grabbed).

Heightened (9th) You can target up to four creatures.

You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Your enchanting performance draws everyone's attention to you, for good or for ill. Opponents have an easier time targeting you, gaining a +1 status bonus to attack rolls against you. However, the distraction makes it more difficult for them to defend themselves and perform more complex tasks. If you Sustain the spell, creatures attempt a new saving throw at the beginning of each of their turns.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against everyone except you for 1 round.

Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

You inspire yourself and your allies with words or tunes of encouragement. You and all allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.beReeFroAx24hj83]{Spell Effect: Courageous Anthem}

Your song moves allies to protect themselves more effectively. You and all allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws, as well as resistance equal to half the spell's rank to physical damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.DLwTvjjnqs2sNGuG]{Spell Effect: Rallying Anthem}

The sound of an emirad's voice carries far. All listeners within 1 mile can hear the emirad loudly and clearly whenever the emirad speaks, even if other ambient noise would otherwise block the sound. The emirad can't choose to speak any more quietly even if they wanted to do so.
The emirad can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r] at will.

Trigger An auditory effect created by the emirad would be counteracted, or the target of an auditory effect created by the emirad would be unaffected due to an active spell or ability

Effect The emirad lets out a cry that will not be silenced. They attempt to counteract the triggering effect, using their Performance modifier as their counteract modifier. On a critical success that counteracts the effect, if the creature who created the triggering effect is within 1 mile, that creature gains weakness 5 to sonic damage for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.battlezoo-bestiary-es-pf2e.sf2e-effects.Item.rLfWtFEeV18mAyxL]{Effect: Listen to my Song!}

Frequency once per minute

Effect The emirad becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round. This additional action can only be used to make a sound bolt Strike, to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.bH0kPuf7UKxRvi2P], or to begin or Sustain Resounding Refrain. The emirad is then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} on their next turn.

Requirements The emirad's last action was a successful sound bolt Strike

Effect The emirad stores up an echo of the sonic energy, preparing for a grand finale. The emirad can Sustain this ability for up to 1 minute. The first time the emirad ends their turn without Sustaining, they make a number of sound bolt Strikes equal to the total number of actions they have spent on Resounding Refrain. These attacks do not apply their existing multiple attack penalty. The multiple attack penalty on these Strikes increases when the emirad makes an additional sound bolt Strike on a creature that they have already targeted with one of their Strikes from Resounding Refrain.
